bugs.symptom: Typing a todo and clicking Add (or pressing Enter) does not add the item to the list. The input may clear or stay filled, but no new todo appears.
Clicking Active or Completed filter tabs does not change which todos are shown. All todos remain visible regardless of the selected filter.
Marking a todo complete works in the UI, but after refreshing the page the completion state is wrong (completed todos appear active again, or active todos appear completed).
Double-clicking a todo to edit and then clicking away (blur) does not save the edited text. The todo reverts to its previous label unless you press Enter.
Clicking Clear completed removes completed todos but also removes active todos that should remain.
